text:
kate: Heads up — I'm handing off ownership of secrets in namespace `payments-stg` to the Payments team. Need a quick sanity check on the TF + Helm changes before I open the PR. Plan: move the sops-encrypted k8s secret into payments repo, update chart values for SA annotation (IRSA), and ensure automount/projected token wiring stays intact. Anyone available to review?

raj: I can take a look. Are you renaming the serviceAccount or just changing the annotation? Need to confirm rolebinding continuity.

kate: Not renaming. SA stays `payments-uploader`. Changing annotation from old arn to `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payments-role`. Helm values patch I'm planning to push:
```yaml
serviceAccount:
  name: payments-uploader
  annotations:
    iam.amazonaws.com/role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payments-role
  automountServiceAccountToken: true
secrets:
  uploader: sops/payments-uploader-secret.yaml
```
Also moving the sops file into payments repo under `secrets/` and referencing it from the chart. TF change is just to add a non-destructive annotation via `helm_release` values override — no k8s_secret resource change.

maria: I'll open the payments repo PR to adopt the secret and update the chart values. Do we need a separate TF change for the IAM role attachment?

raj: If the role already exists and policies are attached, we don't need to touch TF for that. Just ensure infra knows the role ARN you're switching to. I'll review the chart override and the RBAC bindings.

ben: Security note — please don't hardcode long-lived credentials or plaintext ARNs in public files. Using sops for the secret is fine; for the role ARN we should reference a vars file or use repo encryption. Also confirm KMS key grants for sops are set.

kate: Agreed. The ARN will be in a non-public values file (payments-only). KMS grants: I'll list the principals and add a KMS grant request in the PR description.

deploy-bot: CI: helm/chart-lint passed for payments chart (lint v1.4). TF plan (pre-check) shows only a `helm_release` value update — no resource replaces.

maria: Thanks — I'll link the PR here once created. Any objections to me performing the `terraform apply` for payments-stg after approvals?

raj: Infra has no objections, but coordinate the apply window with oncall. Also ping me for the final diff so I can double-check role bindings.

ben: I'll add the KMS grant and review the PR; ping me when it's ready.

kate: Great. I'll assemble a short checklist and drop it in the PR: 1) move sops secret to payments repo, 2) update `serviceAccount.annotations` in values, 3) ensure `automountServiceAccountToken: true`, 4) KMS grant for sops, 5) run smoke pod to verify `aws sts get-caller-identity` inside pod, 6) schedule apply with infra. Will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
